RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure (the MRI) required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed, and our records indicate that this step was not completed by your provider.

You do have the right to appeal this decision. According to our policy, you have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to file a first-level appeal. Additionally, your doctor can submit a "retrospective authorization" request, which includes clinical documentation to show why the MRI was medically necessary for your migraines. If they provide this information, we can review the claim again.

I have attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this message. Please complete it and submit it along with any supporting documentation from your physician. Once received, standard appeals are typically processed within 30 calendar days.

If you have any further questions, please let me know.
